news.description: A malicious website can work out which sites you visit and which apps you open, using nothing but JavaScript and the timing of your SSD. The attack, called FROST , needs no native code, no extension, and no permission prompt.   You open the page, leave the tab sitting there, and it watches the drive for contention in the background.
